// Sorted list of all city names for city search autocomplete
export const CITY_NAMES = Object.keys(LOCALITIES).sort();

/**
 * Helper to get localities for a given city name (case-insensitive)
 * @param {string} city
 * @returns {string[]}
 */
export function getLocalitiesByCity(city = '') {
  if (!city) return [];
  const trimmed = city.trim().toLowerCase();
  // Treat legacy "bangalore" as "bengaluru" (official spelling used throughout the app)
  const normalised = trimmed === 'bangalore' ? 'bengaluru' : trimmed;
  const matchedKey = Object.keys(LOCALITIES).find(
    (k) => k.toLowerCase() === normalised
  );
  return matchedKey ? LOCALITIES[matchedKey] : [];
}

/**
 * Smart city matcher from reverse geocode data
 * @param {string} rawCity
 * @param {string} fullAddress
 * @returns {string}
 */
export function matchCity(rawCity = '', fullAddress = '') {
  const searchStr = `${rawCity || ''} ${fullAddress || ''}`.trim().toLowerCase();
  if (!searchStr) return '';

  const cleanRaw = (rawCity || '')
    .replace(/\s+(District|Urban|Rural|Corporation|Division)$/i, '')
    .trim()
    .toLowerCase();

  // 1. Direct exact match
  if (cleanRaw) {
    const direct = CITY_NAMES.find((c) => c.toLowerCase() === cleanRaw);
    if (direct) return direct;
  }

  // 2. City aliases
  const aliases = {
    bangalore: 'Bengaluru',
    madras: 'Chennai',
    bombay: 'Mumbai',
    calcutta: 'Kolkata',
    cochin: 'Kochi',
    thiruvananthapuram: 'Trivandrum',
    mysuru: 'Mysore',
    gurugram: 'Gurgaon',
    secunderabad: 'Hyderabad',
  };
  for (const [alias, canonical] of Object.entries(aliases)) {
    if (searchStr.includes(alias)) {
      return canonical;
    }
  }

  // 3. Word boundary match against all known cities
  for (const c of CITY_NAMES) {
    const regex = new RegExp(`\\b${c.toLowerCase()}\\b`, 'i');
    if (regex.test(searchStr)) {
      return c;
    }
  }

  return rawCity ? rawCity.replace(/\s+(District|Urban|Rural|Corporation)$/i, '').trim() : '';
}

/**
 * Smart locality matcher from reverse geocode data
 * @param {string} rawLocality
 * @param {string} fullAddress
 * @param {string[]} cityLocalities
 * @returns {string}
 */
export function matchLocality(rawLocality = '', fullAddress = '', cityLocalities = []) {
  if (!cityLocalities || cityLocalities.length === 0) {
    return (rawLocality || '').trim();
  }

  const rawClean = (rawLocality || '').trim().toLowerCase();

  // 1. Exact match in city's locality list
  if (rawClean) {
    const exact = cityLocalities.find((loc) => loc.toLowerCase() === rawClean);
    if (exact) return exact;
  }

  // 2. Substring or inclusion match with rawLocality
  if (rawClean) {
    const sub = cityLocalities.find(
      (loc) => rawClean.includes(loc.toLowerCase()) || loc.toLowerCase().includes(rawClean)
    );
    if (sub) return sub;
  }

  // 3. Scan the full address string for any known locality in this city
  if (fullAddress) {
    const addrClean = fullAddress.toLowerCase();
    const sorted = [...cityLocalities].sort((a, b) => b.length - a.length);
    for (const loc of sorted) {
      const regex = new RegExp(`\\b${loc.toLowerCase()}\\b`, 'i');
      if (regex.test(addrClean)) {
        return loc;
      }
    }
  }

  return (rawLocality || '').trim();
}

export default LOCALITIES;
